reference_law.definition: D_K: all compatible complete cached target atoms before selection, equal mass per distinct latent atom

reference_law.single_target_condition: Equation 6 is an assumed experimental idealization; conflicting exact prompt/target records are retained and audited

theory_comparison_mean.definition: Full-vector mean of 10000 unconditional posterior clean references at the minimum SNR of the prespecified analytical extension on independent Gaussian inputs; no network evaluation
theory_comparison_mean.scope: Finite-selected-SNR Monte Carlo estimate, recorded separately from the exact finite-bank mean; sampling uncertainty and measured bank-to-selected offset remain explicit

conventions.normalization: Raw L2/sqrt(d); squared L2/d. Forward loss averages coordinate sums over draws once.
conventions.indexing: Chronological prediction k=0..K_steps-1; k=0 initialization; native source/destination labels are separate. No branch prediction at final output.
conventions.plotting: Saved compact scalar CSVs only; no inference, tensors, posterior evaluation, integration or summary recomputation
conventions.legacy_registry: legacy_statement_registry.json preserves the previous schema for legacy cache readers
conventions.plan_selection_scope: Fixed after review of SDv1-DDIM; no held-out confirmation claim; apply unchanged to other configurations
conventions.numerical_cache: separate numerical_refinement inputs, policies, and additive collections; old observation/classification receipts retained
conventions.presentation_migration: A16 requires one explicit --recompute-experiments update to save its compact reduction from matched_updates and refresh analysis-source receipts, reusing compatible probes and original variation integrals. --plot then uses saved compact scalars only. The A15 square-root display still preserves its raw saved loss ratio and corollary3-guidance-fit-1. Hash guards and ownership-checked publication remain active; no plot-time scalar backfill or scientific computation.
conventions.theory_mean_source_scope: The selected mean defaults to reference-min-snr. New runs reject --no-mu and --center zero; zero is not a permitted mean_source. Historical saved configurations and scalar meanings remain readable.

statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.title: Initial conditional recovery
statements.exact_statement: L_T(c)/SNR_T -> 0 implies e_T(Z,c) ->_p 0 under Gaussian initialization, with the fixed single-target conditional idealization.
statements.interpretation: One empirical finite-sample RMS per pair; convergence in probability does not imply moment convergence
statements.statistical_unit: Retained pair/seed identities; common prompt-balanced weights for compared populations; pair-only bootstrap where specified
statements.qualification: Gaussian transfer is a plug-in empirical probability check, not a rigorous finite-sample certificate for unbounded loss

preceding_main_figure.y: Initial target error (RMS): paired Y_c and hollow U_c controls with identical connector rule

main_figure.y: paired conditional and unconditional Gaussian target-error RMS

statements.label: Lemma 2
statements.title: Initial unconditional baseline
statements.exact_statement: bar_x_T^K(Z,empty) ->_p mu_K as noise dominates; if e_T^K(Z,empty) ->_p 0 then hat_x_T(Z,empty) ->_p mu_K.
statements.interpretation: 97-point analytical reference-only extension; learned quantities only on the full native range
statements.statistical_unit: Retained pair/seed identities; common prompt-balanced weights for compared populations; pair-only bootstrap where specified
assumptions: Same Gaussian probe bank at each supported native noise level
statements.qualification: Only analytical reference is evaluated below native initialization; complete native Gaussian sweep remains mandatory; no network-limit claim

preceding_main_figure.x: Log SNR from initial SNR*1e-6 through initial SNR; native markers only at initialization

statements.baseline_report: initial_baseline_summary.csv; unique Gaussian seeds about the same mu_K

statements.label: Corollary 3
statements.title: Initial CFG amplification
statements.exact_statement: Under the initial conditional-recovery and unconditional-baseline conditions, g Delta_T ->_p g(x_star-mu_K) and hat_x_T(c;g) ->_p mu_K+g(x_star-mu_K).
statements.interpretation: Exact orthogonal decomposition of full relative injection error; distance to (1,0), not a fitted coefficient
statements.statistical_unit: Retained pair/seed identities; common prompt-balanced weights for compared populations; pair-only bootstrap where specified
statements.qualification: Projection agreement or lying below a loose bound does not establish small full-vector discrepancy

preceding_main_figure.reference_line: Corollary 3 limiting vector (1,0); fixed error contours .25,.5,1

statements.label: Lemma 4
statements.title: Matched one-step CFG displacement
statements.exact_statement: x_next-x_cf=g*kappa_t*Delta_t for the matched affine update with kappa_t>0.
statements.interpretation: Independent matched implementation identity with full-vector residual QA; constructed stochastic cases separately labeled
statements.statistical_unit: Retained pair/seed identities; common prompt-balanced weights for compared populations; pair-only bootstrap where specified
assumptions: Same realized sampler noise and history
statements.qualification: Recovering innovation from the saved endpoint is constructed matching, not independent sampling verification

preceding_main_figure.styling: neutral; marker shape reflects actual independent versus constructed innovation provenance

statements.label: Proposition 5
statements.title: Matched one-step target-posterior feedback
statements.exact_statement: ||Delta_t||>=e_t(c)+e_t^K(empty)+V_t^K implies p_next^K(x_next)>=p_next^K(x_cf), with strict implication for the strict premise.
statements.interpretation: Initial fixed-direction retained-contribution response; no universal increasing-gap/monotone-posterior claim. Full original V and M measured at every eligible nonterminal step.
statements.statistical_unit: Retained pair/seed identities; common prompt-balanced weights for compared populations; pair-only bootstrap where specified
assumptions: Manuscript t>=2; identical endpoint contract or justified saved-versus-affine residual transfer
statements.qualification: Fixed-cache arithmetic and source sensitivity are separate; rigorous intervals include their claimed input construction; original condition sign can resolve negative with unknown V; retain zero coverage and unknown mass
auxiliary_numerical_bounds: midpoint cell truncation<=L_f*w^2/4 plus directed node arithmetic
0<=V<=L_D for both references in the same convex hull
endpoint gradient norms for log p and logit p <=beta*R_K
statements.population: One prompt-balanced structural population per current timestep/outcome group; unknown signs retained in both condition and conclusion denominators

statements.label: Lemma 6
statements.title: Target-specific synchronization
statements.interpretation: Pointwise target-specific synchronization; chronological shape and exact branch motion are measured extensions, not monotonicity or unimodality theorems.
statements.statistical_unit: Retained pair/seed identities; common prompt-balanced weights for compared populations; pair-only bootstrap where specified
statements.qualification: A small gap under a large loose RHS does not establish target recovery; report scales, tightness and small-bound occupancy
audit_equations: Q<=S; decomposition consequence, not a new verbatim lemma

preceding_main_figure.x: Actual current SNR_t over the full trajectory

statements.label: Theorem 7
statements.title: Final reproduction
statements.exact_statement: ||x_0-x_star||<=g e_1(c)+(g-1)[e_1^K(empty)+R_K(1-p_1^K)] under the clean final-update prerequisite.
statements.interpretation: Group-conditional actual/observable/reference terminal tolerance coverage for same-seed SSCD > 0.75 versus <= 0.75; identical populations and prompt-balanced weights within each group, common tolerance axis across groups. Endpoint/bound formulas and numerical QA remain unchanged.
statements.statistical_unit: Retained pair/seed identities; common prompt-balanced weights for compared populations; pair-only bootstrap where specified
statements.qualification: No theorem violations or certifications assigned to inapplicable rows; SSCD never supplies a latent tolerance

finite_terminal_update_extension.predictor_defect: A*z+(kappa-1)*m_g, plus independently supplied additive innovation or declared Gaussian norm bound
finite_terminal_update_extension.gaussian_scope: eta=.05 per scientific run; eta_i=eta/m; q_i=sqrt(chi2.isf(eta_i,d)); simultaneous union bound without trajectory independence
finite_terminal_update_extension.observed_endpoint_policy: Observed endpoint used only as response and separate QA, never predictor-side correction

preceding_main_figure.x: tau/sqrt(d), full positive exact ECDF support with zero mass explicit

main_figure.y: Pr(· ≤ tau): weighted fraction conditional on each terminal-SSCD group
main_figure.group_definition: Each generated seed uses its own terminal SSCD; not prompt-mean SSCD. Exactly 0.75 belongs to the lower group; missing/nonfinite outcomes have explicit exclusions.
main_figure.weighting: Within each group, equal represented prompt-target pair mass divided over eligible member seeds; identical weights for all three quantities; separately normalized group CDFs
main_figure.legend: Gold/purple group colors; solid/dashed/dash-dot actual/observable/reference; outside top, manuscript expressions; corrections and zero/infinite masses in captions
